sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes ZoomMD as cloud EHR, PM & Telehealth platform. Lists 18 years experience, 80+ staff, ~100 practices served. Highlights medical billing services (>95% first-pass collections), medical billing software, EHR, transcription services, and API/FHIR documentation.

ONC mandatory disclosures and certifications page. Lists ZoomMD v4.1 as Certified EHR Ambulatory. Details 40+ regulatory criteria tested including CPOE, security, interoperability. Mentions EHI Export specification, integration with NewCropRx and Surescripts, and 25 CMS clinical quality measures.

API documentation page. ZoomMD API v4.1 provides read-only access to patient data via C-CDA format (base64-encoded XML). FHIR API documentation and endpoints also referenced. Designed for USCDI data elements.

Third-party review site. 4-star rating. Describes ZoomMD as ONC-ACB-certified cloud EHR/PM. Features include custom templates, e-prescribing, patient portal, scheduling, archiving. Targets radiologists, hospitals, surgeons, chiropractors, etc. $395/month starting price.

Third-party review site. Describes flexible charting, ePrescription with EPCS, lab module with national lab connectivity, document management, integrated billing with superbill system, insurance eligibility at check-in. Lists patient portal and telemedicine as NOT included (may be outdated). Targets small to mid-sized offices. 4-star aggregate from 10 ratings.

Third-party listing. Describes ZoomMD for primary care (family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, women's health). Notes billing services with experienced professionals, web-based technology, claims tracking, real-time eligibility. Base software free with charges for support/upgrades.
Attempted to access but got 403 error. Search results indicated ZoomMD supports 40+ specialties and lists features/alternatives.
